title: 'Goondaism isn't a bug': BJP, BRS attack Congress over Meta office vandalism

ai.summary: BJP and BRS accused Congress of vandalising Meta's office in Hyderabad, claiming it damaged 'Brand Hyderabad' and raised safety concerns for businesses in Telangana.

facts.claim: BJP and BRS accused Congress of vandalising Meta's office in Hyderabad
facts.quote: BJP and BRS on Saturday accused the ruling Congress of damaging Hyderabad's business-friendly image after Youth Congress workers vandalised the Meta office in the city on November 20, alleging that the incident had hurt 'Brand Hyderabad' and raised questions about the safety of companies operating in Telangana.

facts.claim: Youth Congress workers vandalised Meta's office in Hyderabad
facts.quote: Youth Congress workers, led by Telangana unit president Jakkidi Shiva Charan Reddy, vandalised the Meta office premises in Hyderabad on November 20.

facts.claim: Youth Congress workers damaged flowerpots during a protest
facts.quote: They damaged flowerpots during a protest against the social media company suspending the accounts of IYC national president Uday Bhanu Chib and other leaders.

facts.claim: Youth Congress workers alleged Meta was acting in favour of BJP
facts.quote: The protesters alleged that Meta was acting in favour of the BJP.

facts.claim: Police took Youth Congress workers into custody
facts.quote: Police took Shiva Charan Reddy and other Youth Congress workers into custody and shifted them to a police station, a Congress leader said.

ai.background_note: Youth Congress workers vandalised Meta's office in Hyderabad on November 20, leading to accusations from BJP and BRS about the incident's impact on 'Brand Hyderabad' and business safety in Telangana.
